[[Stormray]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[KaySey Stormray]], a [[boss]] in the [[Archipelagos]].

== Stats ==
: [[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
: [[HCT|Halves casting time]] of [[Healing Prayers]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
: [[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)

== Skin == 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Jellyfish Wand]].

== Replica ==
This item cannot be replicated, as it: 
* Effectively holds two [[inscription]]s ("Hale and Hearty" and "Aptitude not Attitude") and the latter would instead halve the casting time of Divine Favor spells.
* Is the only Divine Favor wand that deals holy damage. Divine Favor wands usually deal [[fire damage]]. [[Sheco]]'s [[Healing Rod]] for instance, has the same stats as Stormray but deals fire damage.
